Get ready for the ultimate parkour showdown!
We’re hosting a live event and you're invited to compete in 3 intense parkour courses—each with a 10-minute time limit and competitive scoring based on finishing position.

🗓️ Date: Saturday, May 24th
🕗 Time: 8 PM EST
 📍 Location: In CityWar Tower Defense. Go in Noblewood and find Ruby, or if you are late, type /liveevent in your chat to join the event! 💫
→ You can always type /liveevent to spawn in the event lobby if the event is not started.

notes.content:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/8964c37b6afa9ac42aa03b10cc5a5b65088360e9.png

This week's update is centered on Etherdrive, which has new content and improvements:

New content:

-New secret droid NPC that helps you complete a secret puzzle. Destroy barrels to get a chance to spawn the droid, which holds a Power Gem for you and your friends. When the droid spawns, you will need to find 3 different colored pillars in a level, change their colors by interacting with them, to the same color that the droid will be flashing in, once the 3 pillars are the right color, the droid will give a free Power Gem to every player in the map!

-2 new abilities to unlock:
	-Crimson Blast: Creates a small radius powerful explosion at the cursor's position.
	-Shocking Strike: Creates a large radius attack with moderate damage around the cursor's .position.

-2 new achievements to complete and earn cosmetic coins to purchase suits and helmets:
	-Bully: Bully the achievements bot by hitting it many times.
	-Healer: Heal yourself with a health pack many times.

Bug fixes and improvements:

-Added 2 more choices in the starter weapons shop, letting players have more possibilities for which weapon to start with.
-Fixed a bug where no chests would spawn in the 3rd floor.
-Fixed a bug where the doors in the 3rd floor would close before entering a room.
-Fixed some inaccurate colliders on big objects, which would sometimes have projectiles pass through them.
-Fixed a problem where the Boss on the 3rd floor had only 100 HP.
-Increased some of the permanent upgrades efficiency:
	-Every upgrade can be at level 5 now (4 levels max before).
	-Power Shot upgraded to 8% bonus damage per level (up to 40%).
	-Fortitude upgraded to 5% reduction of any damage taken per level (up to 25%).

Head to the storefront to try out the new updates on Etherdrive!

This week, we released a prototype of one of our big upcoming games: Etherdrive.

Etherdrive is a fast paced isometric roguelike shooter where you need to vanquish enemies & epic bosses in randomly generated levels.

Equip yourself with a vast variety of weapon to complete your objectives and progress as far as you can without dying.

In Etherdrive, when a game is lost, you will star over on your next one. To help you to get further in the game, you will unlock skill points to purchase permanent upgrades to make your character stronger.

You can also choose from a modest variety of helmets to have the vibe and look that suits you best!

With this tower, embark in a new dimension inside a giant tesseract, which causes constant damage to every enemy in the map, at any range.

To unlock this tower, you need to unlock with a legendary forge from a lucky coin that you win in the community event!

This week, we went on two of our older games to update and improve them, the first one is Puck Guy, which is now named Sugar Chase!

Here are some of the new things about this game:

-New orthographic camera, which creates a true 2D look!

-New theme, we kept some of the previous visuals of the game, and replaced Pucks for Candies, and we improved the models of enemies.

-New powerups, such as Chewing Gum to slow all enemies and other players down for a short time, a Lollipop to make you invulnerable, faster and giving you the ability to kill enemies, and a Green Candy Bag, that heals you and spawns multiple candies which gives you a lot of points when getting them.

-New enemy, which eats all the candies and scores points, just like you. You have to score more points than him to win the round, and advance the next level, which is getting more and more difficult!

As always you can find this game in Noblewood's arcade, and look for Sugar Chase!

When fully angry, he well unleash his chainsaw and start running at you at a great speed. Make sure you pick up some power-ups to escape more easily and to heal your wounds!

[previewyoutube=6d5JZ_c_IGo;full][/previewyoutube]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/7d909a8943914f204e401020677b4531e4379d2b.png

For the 100th update, we had to do something special, so we released this new fantastic biome: Celestia!

Aside from its heavenly ambiance, this biome offers plenty of new mechanics and tools, while also bringing new enemies.

New tools and mechanics:
-Heaven / Celestial Generator
Uses materials as fuel to generate Celestial Energy.
With enough energy in the storage, the generator will start to provide and turn on objects that need Celestial Energy to function.
When the fuel runs out, powered objects turn off, and the generator will wait for new fuel to be inserted.
Fuel can be inserted over the buttons at the front.

-Heaven / Elemental Sprinkler
Regrows half-harvested Elemental Crystals using Celestial Energy.

-Heaven / Enhanced Coal Factory
Using XP from the Experience Collector Unlockable in the Crab Island Biome,
it will produce enhanced coal.
Needs 50 XP per coal.

-Heaven / Automatic Wood Infuser
Produces any type of infused wood depending on the type of crystal that gets inserted.
Wood can be added manually into the inventory or via an automatic arm.

-Heaven / Automatic Grave Digger
This automatic grave digger will dig out nearby graves and store their items inside its inventory.
Range: 4
Cooldown: 2 seconds

-Heaven / Drone Antenna
The heart of the drone transport system; without it, drones would have no clue what to do.

-Heaven / Drone Base
Every base will add 1 drone into your transport network.
Every drone base in the world will consume Celestial Energy to work.

-Heaven / Drone Provider Chest
Drones will be able to pick up requested items from here.
With the filter button, you will be able to enable/disable certain items.

-Heaven / Drone Request Chest
Set up items the chest will request from the transport network with the button on the object.
Drones will deliver requested items from provider chests and place them in the inventory.

New Enemies:
-Mini watcher:
Regenerates health when left alone for too long and pushes players when attacked, time your attacks to properly fight it.

-Valkyrie:
Hands out a defense buff to any enemies around him, Focus this enemy to restore your damage done.

The biome also offers:
-A new tailor shop
-6 great levels
-3 new towers

To get to this biome, you must complete all of the first primary biomes, and when Ironhold has been completed, you can access to Celestia from the Ironhold's worldmap at the top of the mountain!

With a new biome, we obviously have new towers!

Smg Tower:
-Fires in quick burst any enemy close by.
-Attacks quickly, but needs to reloads after some time.

Crystal Tower:
-Fires out a line of errupting crystal.
-Hits hard and slows target, but has a slow rate of attack.
-Best used in stategic positions.

Celestial Tower:
-Fires a simple shot unto enemies.
-Can be powered up by installing a Celestial generator close by.
-While powered up, it's fire rate is greatly upgraded.

You can purchase these 3 towers from Celestia's Merchant!

-Prepare yourselves between each waves before the blizzard hit.
-During each wave, the blizzard rises up, slowing you down and freezing you progressively.
-Feed the bonfires around the map to heat yourself and fight the cold.
-Defeat the wolves heading out of their cave during the blizzard and gather their pelt.

We released a new game in the arcade: Ghost Hunt.

The objective of this game is to find 3 clues to prove that there is a living ghost. To do so, you can use these tools:

-E.M.F: Reacts when nearby the ghost. If it blinks red, that means you have a clue.

-UV Lamp: While you hold it, if you see glowing fingerprints, you have a clue.

-Thermometer: While you hold the thermometer, if you see that the temperature is below 0 degrees in a room, you have a clue.

-Spirit Box: If you hear a voice when using it, you have a clue. Stay far from your friends do avoid interferences.

-Book: Place the book on the floor in each room, if some writing appears on it, you have a clue.

-Camera: While you hold the camera, if you see gold orbs floating around, you have a clue.

Once you know what the clues are, find the book at the entrance and check the 3 corresponding boxes to prove you found the clues, be careful, this will end the game and determine if you win or lose.

Be also careful as while you are trying to find the clues, the ghost might chase you and eleminate you!

notes.title: Server Maintenance Update: October 25th
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/a24532c6d3df6de403c887b56924d180c2da7fcc.png

Hello Everyone,

We wanted to give you a heads-up about an upcoming server maintenance event:


 Date & Time: The maintenance is scheduled for the night of October 25th, with a critical snapshot happening at 2AM EST.

 Implications: While there's no expected downtime during the restructuring process, please be aware that any progress made after the 2AM snapshot may not be saved. Your data will revert to the state it was in during the last server save.

 Recommendation: We advise you to save your progress and avoid making significant changes after 1:45AM EST to minimize the risk of data loss.

 Purpose: This maintenance is essential to ensure the optimal performance, stability, and cloud support of our servers. We appreciate your understanding and patience. If you need more information you can refer to video update #85. We talk a little bit more about it.

 Post-Maintenance: Once the maintenance concludes, you can continue your activities as usual. We'll notify you once everything is back to normal.


Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. We're always working hard to provide you with the best service possible, and we apologize for any inconvenience this might cause.

Warm regards,

Citywars Tower Defense Team!

This week, we finally released a new biome: Crab Island.

In this biome we have:
-7 new levels
-new merchant with new towers
-new jump and run (brings a tower)
-new biome store 
-New Hair and beards
-New Skins

New mechanics:
-some mobs paths are under water where Guardian Towers will not work (all tower towers with mobs).

-some fierce volcanoes that will shoot fire all over the map, be careful not to step in lava!

-shell throwing dolphins that collects shells from the ocean ground and playfully throws them to players.

-a Trident summoning mermaid (costs 4 shells to purchase her support), which will attack enemies and help you defend your crystal.

-after the first level, players can unlock a floating platform to build towers or any other objects on water.

-Materials like rocks, Branches and fibers are rare in this biome, and you can use the Ocean Collectors to generate additional of these Materials.

New unlocks:
-Floating Platform: can be used to create a platform for towers on water.

-Primitive Ocean Collector: a helpful net that will collect on the water surface floating Materials like rocks, branches and plants for players to pickup (can only hold 1 at a time).

-Mob EXP-Collector: a Modern Experience device that will collect and store some of the XP that mobs after there death leave behind.

-Automatic Ocean Cleaner: a automatic version of the Primitive Ocean Collector that can hold multiple items in his inventory that can be collected. He will automatically shoot all items he collects to the next Shore Station Object on the map.

-Shore Station: a chest like object that will automatically receive items from "Automatic Ocean Cleaners" when there are some on the map can be accessed by all dwarf machines for automation lines
Mob Souls Collector.

-This Object will collect all mob souls that are dropped on the ground and store them in its inventory
Chest Pet Altar, a new helper that can be spawned on maps to help the player attack enemies.

-Mini Tanks, which will follow you and shoot you,

Finally, as some players asked for buffs on certain towers, we added a few improvement on many towers:

-Disco Tower: Added +1 Damage in the damage range and added a 20% chance of critical chance of doing 1.4% damage.

-Will-O-Wisp Tower: Added +1 value on the burning effect.

-Mortar Tower: Closed the gap between minimum and maximum damage, and added 3 damage to the maximum.

-Canon Tower: Reduced the gap between max and min damage by adding +1 to the minimum damage. The overall damage of this tower will not be increased as we want players to prioritize an experience that doesn't require spamming the whole game.

-Clock Tower: Increased projectile speed by 110%, ensuring the accuracy of the tower, which increased the overall efficiency.

-Fireworks Tower: Reduced the cooldown of 0.5 seconds which is the charge up duration between attacks. Also, added a multiplicator of 1.25% on critical, which fixed the critical effects that didn't make sense that were around 0.05%.

-Tiny Tower: Reduced the cooldown between attacks, added 10% critical chance for a total of 30% chance of doing 1.4x damage, added +1 range, increased min and max damage.

-Vine Tower: Added +1 to the max damage on each level, since it's already a decent tower even with the situation we can't make it overpowered to compensate.

-Battering Ram Tower: Added +2 to the overall damage, and added a 20% chance of doing critical damage of 1.4%.

We have a new arcade game: Puck Guy.

In this game, you need to get the most points in a maze, while having to avoid ghosts that will kill you when they touch you.

While playing, you can kill ghosts or other players after you picked up a Power Puck, which will also make you invincible and flash in blue for a few seconds.

To make points, you have three ways:
-Pick up yellow pucks, which equals to 1 point each.
-Pick up Power pucks, which equals to 5 points each.
-Kill a ghost or a player after picking up a Power Puck, worth 10 points each.

When you get killed by a ghost or another player, your score is updated in the leaderboard and reset to 0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/d92182c24acfc2f3323c32a47b3a91f807fb53d9.png

We added a new boss: The Giga Basilisk!

This giant lizard has a lot of health, so to make it easier to defeat you need to prepare poisoned baits made of meat you need to collect from a cow hidden in the map, and poison leaves which can be gathered from eggs the lizard spawns.

When ready, the Basilisk will eat the baits when he passes nearby them, which will make it fall asleep for 10 seconds and make it really vulnerable in the meantime.

The eggs that will be spawned the Basilisk will spawn enemies such as Mushies and Snakes endlessly, so you need to break them, which will also give you the poison leaves necessary to prepare a bait.

You can find this challenging boss in the Fallburg worldmap & once you win, you can unlock the brand new Shotgun Tower!

Our new tower, The Shotgun Tower, is a not so accurate yet powerful weapon, which shoots enemies with a good spread on a low range.

Like mentioned earlier, to unlock this tower you need to defeat the Giga Basilisk, our newest boss.

Make sure you try out this new powerful tower and enjoy the satisfying animations that comes with it.

This boss has a lot of hp and walks slowly towards the Crystal to destroy it. While he is on his path, the Giga Golem will freeze towers like normal Golems, but when he loses too much health, he freezes all of your towers in the map in a second!

To melt the towers and re-enable them, you can use the Purplix acid as usual, but you can also use this special tool: The Acid Explosives. These explosives are scattered all around the road, and when you activate them, it will melt all the crystals around it, while dealing a lot of damage to the enemies.

To activate the explosive, you must place one acid of each color on it (Blue, Green, Red & Yellow), then press the button in the menu to explode it.

When you win this epic fight, you can get the new tower, which we will talk about right now.

In this map, you have a special monolith in the middle of a lake. You can interact with it to spend some Monster Souls and make some wishes, which might help you a lot or disadvantage you, so be careful what you wish for!

The wishes will randomly give one of these effects:

This week we added a new complete biome: Purplix!

This biome contains 5 levels, where you will need to use new tools such as Mushrooms, Brewers and acid to beat the Crystal Golems!

In this biome, Crystal Golems will crystalize towers which will disable them. To re-enable crystalized towers, you will need to follow these steps:

-Grow purplix mushrooms out of crops with the help of a sprinkler.
-Harvest the mushrooms, then put them in purplix brewers, which will create purplix acid.
-Use the purplix acid on crystalized towers to melt the crystals on them.
-You will need to use the right colors for the right tools, which will either be blue, red, green or yellow.

Make sure to team up for this biome as it is surely challenging!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/38cb4bda82a9ea75fcb8d7a98bb97928f7a030a3.png

All the Goblins you will encounter on your journey will have training in the same classes that are available to you! That means that you will find Goblin fighter, Goblin archer, Goblin mage and ... SURPRISE! They also have the same special skill that you have as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/8c142ffab7ae3425ebab5dc69abc158bb6bb1aac.png

You will also encounter special Goblin's with special abilities such as 

Goblin Pirate: boost speed of the mobs around him. 
Goblin Guard: boost 50% defense for the mob around him.
Goblin Shaman: spawns a totem that attacks you if you get too close.

The Goblin's also brought workers with them to supply their war effort. These workers will spawn ressources as they progress towards your crystal. It might help or get in your way depending on what and where they spawn.

You can now create a machine line that will drill for clay, iron, coal carminium etc and a wood or grass cutter that will clear a specific area of trees or grass. Then connect little arms to transfer the raw material to a saw bench or a forge and transform it into planks or ingots. Watch the machines work for you while you concentrate on fighting the horde!  
 
The automatic miner mines nearby minerals and stores the ores inside its container.
Range: 5
Cool down: 2 seconds

The automatic forge smelts any minerals coming from a conveyor into bricks or ingots, then pushes them out on the next conveyor. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/7e8fa93baa19cba720fb39a254a983946e702cbf.png

The automatic tree cutter will cut nearby trees and store logs inside of its container. 
Range: 4
Cool down: 2 seconds
The automatic saw bench cuts all wood logs coming from a conveyor intro planks then pushes them out on the next conveyor. 

The automatic grass cutter will cut nearby grass and store plant fibers inside its container.
Range: 4
Cool down: 2 seconds

The automatic spinning wheel transforms fibers into ropes or fabrics, then pushes them out on the next conveyor.

This week we wanted to offer you a new mini game! The goal of the game is to survive the longest while waves after waves of enemies come for you! This week we released a gamemode we have been working on for a few weeks now. The kart gamemode is bigger than other mini-games we released. It contains a few maps, powerups to defeat your friends and a kart driving mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/3db0f573384bea7bff09399b5c95ea8867d0dc63.png

To find this new gamemode you can go to the arcade room in Noblewood's shop and enter the kart arcade. 

There you will find the kart editor where you can customize your very own kart, there are many colors and parts available. After selecting your kart you can go on and select the map you can play. Then the fun begins! The game will start and will teleport all your friends with you to the selected map. To win, be the first to complete all the laps.

But beware of the powerups as they can change the outcome very fast. You can use them with the left mouse button on the keyboard, or X button on the gamepad controller. You can also drift with space or A button. Drifting for a longer time will give you a small speed boost, very useful to gain an edge on your friends!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2URqxJ9K2l4;full][/previewyoutube]
This week in Citywars we bring you the first villages! Start anew in Soulburg. You did your best in your house, but don't have enough space for all your trophies and furniture? Move to the village and start fresh!

Once you purchase the village you have the ability to lock the gates or to open them so you and your friends have a place together. Everyone can build their home there! Expand together and build multiple homes each with their own interior!

The village is also equipped with the sandbox tool that allows you to spawn enemies for testing your towers. Ideal to have a big party with your friends.

After testing and improving upon the house concept, we felt that was a great addition to the house gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/06c2b46e777b1088a265e41fa8860630c236b0ce.png

There are a lot of new towers this week, each with their own unique mechanic. 

Pursuer Tower: Summons explosive pixies who hunt down enemies and explode on impact.

The Mine tower: Places a mine on the enemies' path. Flying enemies will not trigger the mines.

Icequake Tower: Inflict Splash damage in line with target enemy. Deals Freezing effects. Ignore flying enemies.

Cleansing Tower: A slow and powerful tower that cleanses nearby corrupted ground. 

Froggy Tower: Spawns special frogs that can explode on enemies or give you a random bonus effect when you step on them.

Polymorph Tower: Transform an enemy into a chicken for a short period of time. Kill it before the transformation is undone to make it explode.

Sonar Tower: Shoots normal projectiles on unfocused targets and deals double damage on selected targets. Hit on the tower to select a target type.

notes.title: Update #5 + better framerate!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vlVdMfSSWCs;full][/previewyoutube]

◈𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 3 MAJOR OPTIMIZATIONS  𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 ◈
Since we implemented the Hardcore chalenge last week. Many people complained about fps dropping when the entire level was filled with Monster and Tower. We saw up to 20 players in the same map trying to defeat these hardcore mode. The amount of entities and towers is quite insane xD.

So this week we focused mainly on optimizing the game performance under these difficulty conditions. We found 3 main reasons for fps dropping:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/a84f2ae61110dfa485ff0579c14c889d0b30057c.png
1. Experience Orbs
There is so much going on during these matches that people forget to collect their experience orbs dropped on the ground. Causing massive fps drop due to the sheer quantity of experience orb on the ground.

We implemented a system that merges itemstacks that drop on the ground together. Reducing the individual amount of item stack on the ground without impacting the real quantity dropped.

◈𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 ◈

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/ae49de38039ed2f2e445594385a9a65803b3c325.png
2. Particle Limiter
We implemented a particle limiter that limits the amount of particles running at the same time. If you play a regular world this limiter is configured to be never triggered but if you play a level filled with more than 100 towers shooting exactly at the same mobs. The limiter will enter in effect and limit the amount of particles shooted at the same time. Limiting your game having too many particles at the same time. Which is exactly what happens during the hardcore levels. Everything becomes so chaotic that preventing some particle from spawning is almost not noticeable and helps a lot with keeping the fps stable.

◈𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 ◈

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/86d3287051dff0541e46099bf32b5858837dbd66.png
3. Monster Dead Bodies
Another important issue that caused a important fps drop was the sheer quantity of dead bodies staying on the ground when defeating a massive wave like in the hardcore mode. This was not an issue under regular match but inside the hardcore mode dead entity pile up very very quickly. So we reduced the amount of time a entity takes before despawning, It helps a lot to keep the road easier to understand, especially with the bigger monsters from the hardcore mode and we implemented a cute size reduction animation before despawning them.


◈𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 ◈

These are the 3 main major optimizations done on this week's update. We know new optimizations for an update can be a bit boring but they were a very high priority this week nonetheless we managed to add some new content for you guys :D.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/ae49de38039ed2f2e445594385a9a65803b3c325.png

Every map is now filled with collectables that can be collected at the beginning of the matches. We hid in many maps special crates with special resources which can give you a little boost before the matches.

◈𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 ◈

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/e60c4154a222f16574fe683f45d733d561419b2a.png

No Tower Challenge is like its name suggests a challenge where you can't use any tower to defeat it. You will have to use your fists and weapons to pass this level. This level can be found inside Newlandia hidden at the top of the mountain.

We also introduced a new building that will be an integral part of fallburg in a future update which is the Barack. In exchange for food you can conscript soldiers to help you protect your crystal. notes.title: We worked non-stop for a week!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wkJDgNO9qoQ;full][/previewyoutube]
We optimized a lot of stuff on the server to make our server quicker and more efficient. We merged requests for projectiles into 1 request to the server taking up much less space on the servers. You can imagine how many projectiles take up space in a tower defense game. Shooting stuff is half the game! We did the same for a lot of other processes and that made a huge difference on the server.

We added new content! A completely new resource that allows for even higher tower upgrades. Introducing GOLD unlock and recipe! But to get it you will have to be prepared because it will come with an otherworldly threat. Available for players that have completed Noblewood (blue world) and part of Hopetown to get at least 2 unlock points(it comes right after the Green Crystal upgrade). With that we guarantee you will get those pesky 3 stars you’ve been working so hard for.

We finally added a proper reward for the super mini and near impossible secret map! You will get your very own brag trophy! If you already completed this map send us a message (with a screenshot with your name in it) in our Discord we will arrange for you to get it :-D. https://discord.com/invite/citywarssavage in the got-trophy channel.

Since we are in early access we need to update and fix stuff as we go while you are all online. That means that to implement new updates to make the experience better, we need to restart our servers often. We just added a much clearer message that will appear on your screen and in the chat so you can stay up to date with what’s going on on our side and when a server update will take place. Don’t worry you progress will be saved and server restarts usually don't take more than 10 seconds. Hope this can alleviate some of the frustration of the game closing in your face :-D. We don’t like doing it, believe us but it's a necessary evil. 

◈𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓 𝅒 𝅓   ◈

At first, the tutorial was designed to be played alone but people kept teleporting to their friend to help them complete it. This was causing the tutorial to break, it also happened when you left in between an enemy wave animation or if your game crashes during the tutorial. You won't see any difference visually but it is now a lot more robust. It was important to us to change it but we understand now why so many games avoid having their tutorial multiplayer. If you had issues at this point and want to try the game again please reconnect and try it!

We know the current friend list is difficult to use. We didn't have the time to work on it this week as we had to focus on latency optimization. To temporarily help with the problem we added a new command. Use /addfriend  to add a friend to your friend list automatically. No more scrolling through the mile long list. Then you can teleport to them easily and party up. We will make the process even easier and more streamlined soon, we promised. But right now it’s a quick fix :-D.

Merchants are now easier to find with a yellow exclamation point over their head.

In bulk


 Added a Looking for group channel in our discord. Super easy now to party up and go defeat those pesky maps you didn’t get 3 stars for.   
 Added voice channels to our discord server.
 Descriptions for some towers and some items are clearer in english (which should help with translation as well).
 Fixed the exit map portal (the tents). It was resetting your map wrong and you started the game with no resources and a wave already incoming. Now it’s back to normal.
 BB code won’t break the chat anymore. It will only be available to staff for the moment.

notes.title: Citywars Tower Defense first official update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ZYk8FjRaN_o;full][/previewyoutube]
Hi Everyone,

We, Darkirby3 and Linkupdated are really happy to bring you the first official update of Citywars Tower Defense! We first want to thank you guys for the huge interest toward our little project. We could not have wished for more at this point. (No really stop, you're so many on our poor server it barely holds up! XD ). The last 48 hours were a roller coaster of excitement and panic as we saw all of you flooding the game in such great numbers! A steady flow of 200 players were in the game at all times when we expected 50 to 70. Thank you so much!

But with an unexpectedly successful game comes a bunch of unexpected issues. For us it was big lag spikes issues. When we got to 200 concurrent players the server experienced problems and as much as we optimized it before it was not enough.

But fear not! We will always protect the Massively multiplayer! You will soon be able to enjoy even more streamlined gameplay and less lags issues as we keep fixing and updating the game. 

Here's what we have done so far. To ease the pain of our poor server we have bought a brand new server. Bigger is better! You now have a stronger server set up to pick up the slack and accommodate more players. We optimized the database. We streamlined our maps and music. There is still a lot more to do but we are on the right track to offer the multiplayer experience you deserve guys.  

We are so happy to have made the switch during this all nighter shift! Hope you can experience the difference too. 
We are still working on a solution for all players far away from Canada. 

We also improved the feel of the game.

No more blinding white character customization and tutorial map. Sit back and relax in our new and improved tropical island tutorial. Easily set all your basic character features, including his voice (wow :-o !), under the palm tree shade smelling the ocean breeze.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/4952418eb2c0f8b6407e51e25b9e86260aa70fd5.png

2022 Politically Correct here we come! No more taco, seamen and Rodolf Miller in the chat. We implemented a spam and swear filter to create a more fun and friendly environment in-game. It
s still a work in progress, but we are hard at work to make it better. Enjoy the chat and connect with players in the game to try and defeat our most difficult challenges like the secret hidden map of Noblewood. Special thanks to @Fist Bump That provided us with a good list of bad words. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/9eda2d5694f52f60afb8c573bf545db1050b601f.png

Visit the prestigious Hopetown and buy new jewelry to show off to all your friends how much sweat and blood you shed on your journey there. You can spend all your money however you want it! Treat yourself to luxury and become the talk of the town!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/8fc674140d72e35d0c9eca656546ba9985941938.png

Finally, sorry for everyone who experienced the error of the spooky naked white baby. With the flow of players on our potato server the map corrupted itself and people got stuck inside an empty white area. We fixed the area and completely remade the look of the spawn of the server.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41958868/961afd11f926f6c5ad674447f72cb15b9787dd3e.png

We will continue to release patches as issues are identified and resolved. If you experience any issues, let us know by submitting a bug report on our discord channel.

Thank you,
01 Studio
